hypotheses.justification: The existing proof works unchanged without _hy. Unfolding reduces the equality to (r * y.2.1) / (r * y.1) = y.2.1 / y.1 using Real.rpow_zero. Mathlib's mul_div_mul_left requires only r ≠ 0, supplied by hr.ne', with no restriction on y.1. In particular, when y.1 = 0 both quotients are zero.
